cases.title: 故意让本地提交失败
command: rolls back the durable event and projector when the local commit fails
cases.observation: 业务投影、event 行、event_sequence 行均回滚。

cases.title: 关掉历史载荷保留
command: projects durable events without retaining their payloads|omits live-only events from durable aggregate streams
cases.observation: durable 投影与序号提交，event 载荷可不留存。纯实时事件没有进入 durable aggregate stream。

cases.title: 批量提交与历史流交接
command: publishes a durable batch atomically in provided order|rolls back every batch event when a projector fails|catches durable aggregate events published during replay handoff
cases.observation: 批量按给定顺序原子提交，投影失败时整批回滚，历史流与后续实时事件衔接时没有遗失该窗口的已提交事件。

cases.title: 事件版本与 replay owner
command: dispatches durable projectors by exact event version|claim fences replay owners
cases.observation: 对应历史版本的投影器才执行，其他事件同步所有者受到 replay claim 约束。

cases.title: 接收问候后显式恢复
command: executes one recorded prompt through the recorded HTTP transport
cases.observation: resume:false 先接收输入，显式 resume 后投影用户和助手消息，模型回复来自原版 HTTP 录制。

cases.title: 交付同一条输入并保持顺序
command: consumes the pending row and projects the message at promotion|orders projected messages and context by durable aggregate sequence
cases.observation: 输入投影消费待处理行，消息和历史按聚合序号排序。

cases.title: 重放输入投影不启动 Runner
command: reprojects pending inbox input without scheduling execution
cases.observation: 项目重放可重建待交付内容，重放本身不调度执行。

cases.title: 助手子项和媒体引用
command: reads the same reply when experimental.part_rows is switched on, off and on again mid-session|stores media once and refs it from inbox, message, and tool rows
cases.observation: 切换 part_rows 仍读取到同一条回复。开启 media_blob 后，多类会话对象通过引用使用同一份媒体内容。

cases.title: 运行认领：用户中断与服务关闭
command: claims at execution start, releases on completion, and preserves through teardown|a user interrupt releases the claim
cases.observation: 正常结束和用户中断释放认领，服务 Scope 关闭保留未完工作的认领。

cases.title: 后台子 Agent 仍在运行
command: resumes a background subagent and notifies its parent exactly once
cases.observation: 恢复扫描再次计入运行尝试，只恢复一次子执行，最后只给父会话一份报告。

cases.title: 报告已完成，退出发生在投递之前
command: delivers a completed outbox row at boot without touching the child|reconciles an outbox row whose notification was already delivered
cases.observation: 待投递报告可直接补发，已交付的报告可对账。子 Session 不需要为生成报告再运行一次。

cases.title: 恢复预算与显式取消
command: terminalizes a recovered subagent that exhausts its resume budget|honors a job cancellation persisted
cases.observation: 预算耗尽走失败终态，已经持久化的取消仍然有效。

cases.title: 前台 Shell 已经退出，恢复后的 Session 怎样继续
command: settles a foreground call.*and resumes its session
cases.observation: 测试宿主更换服务 Scope，通过测试守护进程恢复工具结果，再推进会话。
